annual_descriptions.description: A free and open source realtime collaborative editor
A free and open source realtime collaborative editor

cohort.exclusions: All repositories outside the two named members, private/deleted/inaccessible projects, nested manifests, dev/build/optional/peer dependencies, and other branch lineages. No replacements for missing metadata. Current application-purpose labels are selection strata, not historical category observations.
cohort.sampling_rule: Freeze the acquired default branch head. Walk its full first-parent chain in topology order; select the first commit with committer timestamp strictly before January 1 UTC of the following year. This is a retrospective branch-lineage sample, not a reconstruction of historical default branches. No eligible commit in a complete history is unavailable_history, not an empty declaration set.
cohort.selection_rule: Prospectively frozen two-member application extension before annual extraction. Purposeful maximum-contrast cases: Node-RED visual event-driven programming and Etherpad collaborative document editing, from separate owner namespaces outside Pallets. Public primary repository descriptions inspected 2026-10-24. Chosen for end-user application purpose and JavaScript comparability with the existing library cohort, not observed dependency trajectories. This is a convenience case study, not a probability sample or an estimate of independent governance.
